name: nextcloud
description: Nextcloud (Apache image, MariaDB): DB auto-detection dumps the MariaDB (root -> all databases). The app folder is backed up including config/ and data/ (the user files); the raw DB data dir is excluded - the logical dump replaces it. Only regenerable data is excluded: thumbnails (data/appdata_*/preview), user cache (data/*/cache) and unfinished chunk uploads (data/*/uploads). Assumption: datadirectory = /var/www/html/data (volume ./nextcloud) - adjust the excludes if the volume/data path differs. NOTE: For strictly consistent backups, enable maintenance mode before the backup (occ maintenance:mode --on) and disable it again afterwards.
